        Mod998 mod = new Mod998();

        public void solve(int testNumber, InputReader in, PrintWriter out) {
            int n = in.nextInt();
            long k = in.nextLong();
            if (k == 0) {
                out.println(mod.fact(n));
                return;
            }

            if (k > n - 1) {
                out.println(0);
                return;
            }

            int c = n - (int) k;

            long answer = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= c; i++) {
                long term = mod.mult(mod.paritySign(c - i), mod.ncr(c, i), mod.pow(i, n));
                answer = mod.add(answer, term);
            }

            answer = mod.mult(answer, 2, mod.ncr(n, c));
            out.println(answer);
        }
    }

        public long modulus() {
            return 998_244_353L;
        }
    }

        private final List<Long> invFactorial = new ArrayList<>();

        public abstract long modulus();

        public Modulus() {
            factorial.add(1L);
            invFactorial.add(1L);
        }

        public long fact(int n) {
            while (factorial.size() <= n) {
                factorial.add(mult(factorial.get(factorial.size() - 1), factorial.size()));
            }
            return factorial.get(n);
        }

        public long fInv(int n) {
            int last = invFactorial.size() - 1;
            if (last < n) {
                long[] temp = new long[n - last];
                temp[0] = inv(fact(n));
                for (int i = 1; i < temp.length; i++) {
                    temp[i] = mult(temp[i - 1], n - i + 1);
                }
                for (int i = temp.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    invFactorial.add(temp[i]);
                }
            }
            return invFactorial.get(n);
        }

        public long paritySign(long k) {
            return (k & 1) == 0 ? 1 : modulus() - 1;
        }

        public long ncr(int n, int r) {
            if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
            return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
        }

        public long normalize(long x) {
            x %= modulus();
            if (x < 0) x += modulus();
            return x;
        }

        public long add(long a, long b) {
            long v = a + b;
            return v < modulus() ? v : v - modulus();
        }

        public long mult(long... args) {
            long r = 1;
            for (long x : args) r = mult(r, x);
            return r;
        }

        public long mult(long a, long b) {
            return (a * b) % modulus();
        }

        public long pow(long base, int exp) {

                exp = -exp;
